questions.q: What is the only permitted opening in an abutment or firewall, and what is its maximum clear width?

A vent well with a clear width of 1.00 meter.
A vision panel with a clear width of 0.50 meter.

Building Bulk
Air Rights

questions.q: The Allowable Maximum Building Footprint (AMBF) is measured from which part of the building?

The center line of the interior walls.
The edge of the roof eaves or projections.

questions.n: The AMBF represents the true buildable area occupied by the building at grade level, measured to its outer boundaries.

o: 0.86 sq. meter area and 225 kilograms capacity.

o: The average natural grade level of the buildable area.
The lowest point of the adjoining lot.
The highest point of the adjoining natural grade.

An awning is made of concrete, while a canopy is always made of fabric.

questions.q: What comprises the 'Total Open Space within Lot' (TOSL)?

Maximum R-2

Any floor that contains the same gross floor area as the podium.
The ground floor plan that serves as the basis for all other levels.

A system where the driver and driven rotate on different axes at different speeds.

The natural grade level.

Evaporator

Evaporator
questions.n: The compressor 'squeezes' the refrigerant gas, raising both its pressure and temperature.

questions.q: What is the requirement for a professional to be an 'Authorized Inspector' of machinery?
o: Any Licensed Architect with a safety certificate.
A Registered Master Plumber.
A Civil Engineer with 2 years of field experience.
A Professional Mechanical Engineer with 10 years of experience.
questions.n: The code mandates high-level licensure (PME) and a full decade of relevant experience.

questions.q: What is 'Total Open Space within Lot' (TOSL)?
o: The area of the roof deck.
The total area of the lot (TLA).
The area of the public sidewalk in front of the house.
The sum of the ISA and the USA.
questions.n: TOSL accounts for all areas of the lot not occupied by the building footprint (AMBF).

questions.q: An 'Arcade' is defined as which of the following?
o: The balcony located inside a theater.
A video game room in a commercial building.
A roofed or covered sidewalk.
A row of trees along the RROW.
questions.n: Arcades provide a sheltered path for pedestrians along the building frontage.

questions.q: What defines 'Enclosed' in the context of mechanical safety?
o: The machine is in a room with a locked door.
Moving parts are guarded to prevent human physical contact.
The machine is turned off and unplugged.
The machine is submerged in a vat of oil.
questions.n: Enclosure is a safety measure to ensure no fingers or limbs can reach moving machinery.

questions.q: Which of these is the primary purpose of a 'Billboard' according to the code?
o: To identify the name of the owner of the house.
A panel for posting bills or posters.
To provide shade for a parking lot.
To display the address of the building.
questions.n: The name comes from its function as a board for 'bills' (advertisements/notices).

questions.q: What is the 'Floor Area Ratio' (FAR)?
o: The ratio of the building's length to its width.
The ratio between the ground floor and the second floor.
The number of floors divided by the height of the building.
The ratio between GFA and the Total Lot Area (TLA).
questions.n: FAR is a density control that limits how many total square meters you can build based on lot size.

questions.q: What is an 'Easement' under the National Building Code?
o: A wall built on the property line.
The right to use a neighbor's swimming pool.
A public open space along bodies of water that must be free of building obstructions.
A discount on the building permit fee.
questions.n: Easements are reserved for public use, environmental protection, and light/ventilation along waterways.

questions.q: How is the 'Building Height Limit' (BHL) determined?
o: Based on the proposed occupancy and other development controls.
Based on the owner's budget.
By the strength of the soil.
By the height of the tallest building in the same city.
questions.n: Zoning laws and occupancy types (R-1, R-2, etc.) dictate the maximum allowed height.

questions.q: What defines a 'Business Sign'?
o: A sign that identifies a business conducted on the same premises.
Any sign made of high-quality plastic.
A sign that advertises a product sold in a different province.
A sign that uses flashing lights to attract attention.
questions.n: A business sign is an 'on-site' identification for the services offered in that building.

questions.q: What is an 'Automatic Fire Suppression System'?
o: A 911 call center.
A bucket of water kept near the kitchen.
A fire extinguisher that you have to pick up and spray.
An engineered system that detects and suppresses fire without human intervention.
questions.n: The 'automatic' part means it triggers on its own using heat or smoke sensors.

questions.q: What is the 'Percentage of Site Occupancy' (PSO)?
o: The area of the yard divided by the footprint.
The number of rooms in a building.
The AMBF divided by the Total Lot Area (TLA).
The GFA divided by the TLA.
questions.n: PSO expresses what percentage of the land is covered by the building footprint.

questions.q: What defines a 'Boiler' or 'Steam Generator' in mechanical code?
o: A large fan that blows hot air.
A device that cools water using ice.
A closed vessel for heating water or generating steam for external use.
An open pot used to boil water for a restaurant.
questions.n: The 'closed vessel' and 'external use' parts are the key legal identifiers for boilers.

questions.q: What is 'Redevelopment' as defined in the NBCP?
o: Moving a building from Manila to Cebu.
Painting a building a new color.
Physical development of under-utilized, unsafe, or unfit lots.
Building a new house on a virgin forest lot.
questions.n: Redevelopment involves upgrading or rebuilding on existing urban land to better serve its purpose.

questions.q: How does 'Total Gross Floor Area' (TGFA) differ from GFA?
o: TGFA is for houses; GFA is for offices.
TGFA is measured in cubic meters; GFA in square meters.
TGFA is the area of the lot; GFA is the area of the building.
TGFA includes everything (parking, shafts, lobbies); GFA is the 'usable' area.
questions.n: TGFA is the most comprehensive measure of all enclosed building space.

questions.q: What is the primary function of a 'Crane'?
o: To generate steam for a laundry facility.
To act as a safety buffer at the bottom of a shaft.
To transport small food items in a car with 0.86 sq.m area.
To lift, lower, and move a load horizontally.
questions.n: Cranes are defined by their ability to provide three-dimensional movement for heavy loads.

questions.q: Which sign type is limited to a display surface not exceeding 10.00 square meters?
o: Ground Sign
Banner
Wall Sign
Billboard
questions.n: Ground signs (on poles or pylons) have this specific size restriction in the NBCP definitions.

questions.q: What is a 'Condemned Boiler'?
o: A boiler that has been painted red.
A boiler that is more than 50 years old.
A vessel inspected and declared unsafe by an authority.
A boiler used in a criminal's hideout.
questions.n: Condemnation is the formal legal process of banning a boiler from use for safety reasons.

questions.q: What is the requirement for a 'Yard' to be included in the TOSL?
o: It must be at least 10 meters deep.
It must abut a permanent public open space without obstructions.
It must contain at least five trees.
It must be paved with high-quality tiles.
questions.n: A yard must have access to light and air from a public space to truly count as 'open space'.
